title: Bozzetto
content: Tiepolo Giovanni Battista(1696/ 1770), oil, 39 cm x 68 cmBozzettois an Italian term that refers to a comprehensive color sketch to work out an overall composition. It often intended for approval by a client or patron, or else to work out the ensemble for the satisfaction of the artist. It is usually undertaken without models or reference.Antonio Canova, terra cotta bozzetto of Adam and Eve.Bozzettocan also refer to a sculptor's study of a figural grouping to establish the broad masses, typically executed in terra cotta.---Synonyms:Maquette(French word for sculptural sketch),Modello(Another Italian word for a comprehensive oil sketch).
